source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project (IFAD-funded) - "Climate Resilient Banana Growing Technique" (ផលិតកម្មដំណាំចេកដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), November 2018
text: On sloped or erosion-prone land, the booklet recommends contour-based planting layouts to slow runoff and retain topsoil and rainfall on site, an important climate-resilience measure given more erratic rainfall intensity. During the first growing season, before the banana canopy closes, farmers can intercrop the wide inter-row space with fast-cycle vegetables such as corn or leafy vegetables for additional income from the same land.
